Alger, 22 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — EYC: Algiers, August 22, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — EYCONET, an Algerian startup support network, and AfriLabs Connect Deal Room (ACDR), a pan-African innovation player, are formalizing a strategic partnership. The framework agreement aims to facilitate local startups' access to African financing and markets.
Une alliance pour briser les barrières d: An alliance to break down continental market barriers
ALGER — Le secteur des start-ups algérie: ALGIERS — The Algerian startup sector is passing a major milestone with the signing of a memorandum of understanding between EYCONET and AfriLabs Connect Deal Room (ACDR). This non-binding yet structuring partnership aims to remove the obstacles that still limit the expansion of local companies beyond national borders. Until now, many promising startups have struggled to gain visibility among African investors due to a lack of suitable communication channels.
L’accord repose sur une collaboration en: The agreement is based on a three-pronged collaboration: EYCONET acts as a detector and pre-qualifier of projects, while ACDR guarantees a reliable and qualified flow of investment opportunities (deal flow). For entrepreneurs, the stakes are twofold: accessing pan-African funding and integrating a network of partners on a continental scale.
Le partenariat s’articule autour de rôle: The partnership is structured around defined roles for each party. EYCONET, acting as the local relay, is tasked with sourcing high-potential startups. This step includes an in-depth due diligence procedure to assess their financial, technical, and strategic robustness. The selected projects are then presented as investment-ready files.
De son côté, AfriLabs Connect Deal Room: For its part, AfriLabs Connect Deal Room provides a qualified pipeline of projects, offering investors direct access to pre-selected opportunities. The emphasis is on companies operating in DeepTech sectors (artificial intelligence, biotechnologies, clean energy) or showing rapid growth (scale-ups).
Un écosystème sous le signe de l’innovat: An ecosystem driven by innovation and institutional support
Ce projet bénéficie du soutien du minist: This project benefits from the support of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Startups and Micro-enterprises, as well as the Algerian Startup Fund (ASF), a public fund dedicated to innovation. This institutional involvement strengthens the alliance's credibility among African economic players.
Par ailleurs, ce partenariat s’inscrit d: Furthermore, this partnership is part of the momentum leading up to the upcoming African Startup Conference (ASC), a major continental event that will bring together decision-makers, investors, and entrepreneurs. Algeria's participation in this event is thus expected to gain visibility and impact.
Le deal flow, clé de voûte d’une stratég: Deal flow, the keystone of an attractiveness strategy
Les écueils rencontrés par les écosystèm: The pitfalls encountered by emerging ecosystems often lie in the absence of a structured process for presenting projects to investors. An effective deal flow is not limited to a list of names: it relies on rigorous evaluation, total transparency, and professional formatting of files. EYCONET assumes this role of filter and preparer, identifying local gems and ensuring their compliance with the requirements of funders.
